latest_final: The student was at HKU and needed to choose courses before the deadline. Rather than the courses simply filling up or vanishing through a system error or accidental click, the loss was caused by the student's own request made in a spoken/phone conversation with someone able to act on the enrollment record. The student asked that person to check, confirm, or resolve a problem with the courses—not to switch them. That person then carried out an operation on the student's enrollment at the student's request, which ended up clearing all the courses from the record. Later, when the student checked, all the courses were gone, as though they had disappeared in one evening. So the student lost the courses because their own request to that person led to their enrollment being wiped.
